description:
Container archival follows tracker document references. Artifacts whose owner is established by an identifier or commit provenance but which carry no document reference are linked at their current path.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every manifest row whose owner is established by identifier or commit provenance has a tracker document reference on that owner at the artifact's current path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Multi-owner rows are linked to every recorded owner; rows without admissible evidence receive no link.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tracker validation and document conformance report no new findings.
title: Link unlinked owned artifacts to their issues
